signals.title: Congo’s Ebola cases surpass 10,000 as fears grow of wider African spread
signals.summary: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in Democratic Republic of Congo has risen above 10,000, government data showed on Tuesday, a milestone that coincides with growing fears the epidemic could spread to more African countries.

signals.title: Le Niger affirme qu'une frappe de drone du Tchad a tué deux civils
signals.summary: Le Niger a qualifié cette frappe d’« acte d’agression » et de « violation flagrante » de sa souveraineté. Niamey accuse le Tchad d'avoir perpétré cette attaque avec le soutien de la France.

signals.title: Cameroun: au procès sur la mort de Martinez Zogo, un accusé affirme avoir été poussé à en incriminer un autre
signals.summary: Au Cameroun, le procès sur l’assassinat de Martinez Zogo, animateur vedette retrouvé mort en 2023 à Yaoundé, a repris ce 26 octobre. Durant cette audience consacrée aux témoignages de deux officiers de la commission d’enquête sur ce crime, l’un des principaux accusés, l’ex-directeur des opérations du contre-espionnage (DGRE), a affirmé n’avoir mis en cause l’homme d’affaires Jean-Pierre Amougou Belinga qu’après avoir reçu la visite de « certains hommes ». Les ayants…

signals.title: Niger accuses Chad of deadly drone attack in which two civilians died
signals.summary: The military authorities say they have summoned the Chadian ambassador over the incident and are demanding compensation for the damage caused.

signals.title: Residents Fault Delayed Response As Fire Engulfs Rongai Apartments
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- Residents of Ongata Rongai in Kajiado County have raised concerns over emergency preparedness after a fire broke out at a five-storey apartment building behind Maasai Mall on Tuesday morning.

signals.title: Sixty Christians killed in Ethiopia’s Oromia region
signals.summary: Church officials say more than 20 people have been injured, while 20 homes have burned down as religious tensions flare.

signals.title: Ruto Orders KPC to Withdraw Case Blocking Sh3bn Compensation for Makueni Oil Spill Victims
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- President William Ruto has directed the Kenya Pipeline Company (KPC) to withdraw a court case that has delayed the payment of Sh3 billion in compensation to more than 3,000 people affected by the 2015 oil spill in Makueni County.

signals.title: Ebola - How Much Have Nigerian States Allocated to Emergency Preparedness?
signals.summary: [Premium Times] Some states made substantial provisions for health emergencies, while others allocated smaller sums to specific disease-control activities.

signals.title: Gauteng Malaria Spike Was Due to Travel in Flood Regions, Experts Conclude
signals.summary: [Daily Maverick] The sudden spike in malaria cases in Gauteng earlier this year - with more than 400 infections and 11 deaths in the first three months of 2026 - has been attributed to people visiting neighbouring provinces and countries soon after the severe January floods hit large parts of southern Africa.

signals.title: Afrique du Sud: Eugene de Kock, ancien bourreau, entendu par une commission sur la justice post-apartheid
signals.summary: En Afrique du Sud, c’est un nom qui, encore aujourd’hui, fait resurgir les fantômes du passé. Eugene de Kock – connu dans le pays sous le surnom de Prime Evil («le mal incarné») – a torturé et tué nombre d’opposants politiques avec son escadron de la mort sous l’apartheid. À la chute du régime, il n’avait pas obtenu l’amnistie pour certaines de ces atrocités et a passé deux décennies en prison. À 77 ans, il était entendu, ce lundi 26 octobre, comme témoin dans le cadre de…

signals.title: Mali: treize civils tués par une frappe de drone de l'armée, dans la région de Tombouctou
signals.summary: Au Mali, treize civils, dont six enfants, ont été tués, dans la nuit de dimanche à ce lundi 26 octobre, par une frappe de drone de l'armée malienne, près de Lerneb, dans la région de Tombouctou, selon des informations vérifiées par RFI auprès de nombreuses sources locales. L'état-major n'a pas communiqué sur cette frappe.

signals.title: More than 60 Christians killed in Ethiopia 'massacre', church official says
signals.summary: One resident, whose 75-year-old father was killed, described it as an ambush, saying they were surrounded.

signals.title: RDC: Saúde mental é prioridade em resposta ao Ébola
signals.summary: Na Républica Democrática do Congo, até dia 20 de Outubro, havia 9.704 casos confirmados de ébola e 4.687 mortes. O médico português Tomás Bandeira, responsável de medicina tropical da organização Médicos Sem Fronteiras (MSF), em Mongbwalu, no Leste do país, junto à fronteira com o Uganda, defendeu à agência Lusa que a saúde mental é uma prioridade na resposta à epidemia de Ébola.

signals.title: Ebola en RDC : un infirmier tué dans la province de la Tshopo
signals.summary: Un infirmier engagé dans la riposte contre l'épidémie d'Ebola a été tué dans la province de la Tshopo, en République démocratique du Congo, a annoncé l'OMS dimanche.

signals.title: Moyale Clashes Leave Trail of Death, Destruction Across Seven Districts - Tens of Thousands Flee to Kenya
signals.summary: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- Fighting triggered by a dispute over the display of the Somali regional state flag in border city Moyale, a city administered by both Oromia and Somali regions, has spread across seven districts over the weekend, leaving a trail of deaths, injuries and property destruction. Tens of thousands have also fled across the border into Kenya seeking safety.

signals.title: Nurse killed in attack while responding to Ebola alert in DR Congo
signals.summary: Local youths reportedly accused the health workers of contaminating water sources and spreading Ebola.

signals.title: Nigeria: 50 killed in bandit attack on Taraba village
signals.summary: The death toll from an attack by gunmen on a rural village in eastern Nigeria on Friday has risen to 50, survivors told AFP on Sunday, after more bodies were discovered.

signals.title: 'We Shall Meet in Court' - Babu Refuses to Apologise to Sakaja Over Collapsed Building Claims
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- Embakasi East MP Babu Owino has dared Nairobi Governor Johnson Sakaja to take him to court over his allegations linking City Hall to the collapsed Eastleigh building, insisting he will not apologise as he demands accountability for the deaths and suffering caused by the tragedy.

signals.title: Une attaque de "bandits" fait au moins 50 morts dans l'est du Nigeria
signals.summary: Des hommes armés se sont attaqués vendredi à un village rural de l’est du Nigeria, tuant des dizaines de personnes et pillant des magasins. Le bilan est passé à 50 morts dimanche.

signals.title: Ruto Announces Sh70bn Cement Factory in Kitui, Says Project Will Create 4,000 Jobs
signals.summary: [Capital FM] KITUI, Kenya, Oct 26, 2026 -- President William Ruto has announced plans to launch a Sh70 billion cement and clinker factory in Ngaaie, Mwingi North Constituency, Kitui County, on Tuesday, in a project expected to create 4,000 jobs and boost economic activity in the region.

signals.title: PM Nabbanja to Outlines Plans to Improve Food Security and End Malnutrition
signals.summary: [Independent (Kampala)] Kampala -- Prime Minister Robinah Nabbanja will this morning release the latest Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) analysis at the Office of the Prime Minister, alongside the Ministers of Agriculture, Health, and Disaster Preparedness. The report paints a picture of a nation grappling with climate shocks, economic pressure, and shrinking humanitarian lifelines.

signals.title: Kenya : au moins 24 morts dans une collision entre un bus et un camion
signals.summary: Une collision entre un bus et un camion sur une autoroute kenyane a fait au moins 24 morts dimanche. L’excès de vitesse et le mauvais état des routes ont déjà été cités comme facteurs contribuant aux accidents de la route dans le pays.

signals.title: 'National emergency': 24 dead in Kenya bus crash near site of previous fatal accident
signals.summary: A bus collided with a truck on Kenya's main highway on Sunday, killing at least 24 people, police said. The crash came three weeks after 17 people died in another accident along the same highway linking the capital, Nairobi, with the coastal city of Mombasa.

signals.title: Le Parlement algérien convoqué en urgence : s’achemine-t-on vers une intervention au Niger ?
signals.summary: Députés et sénateurs algériens seront convoqués en urgence ce dimanche 25 octobre et, si l’objet de cette réunion n’est pas précisé, tout porte à croire qu’il s’agit de leur faire valider l’envoi de troupes au Niger, en accord avec le pouvoir de Niamey.

signals.title: Preparing for the storm — grassroots action drives Durban’s climate disaster response
signals.summary: By combining immediate humanitarian relief with long-term urban planning, the Durban Coalition and Gift of the Givers demonstrate how grassroots solidarity can protect vulnerable communities from extreme weather.

signals.title: Public Urged to Learn Flood Rescue Skills
signals.summary: [Daily News] A WATER rescue expert has urged citizens to learn basic first aid and rescue techniques to save lives during El Niño related flooding before professional emergency teams arrive.

signals.title: Cameroun : dix ans après la tragédie ferroviaire d'Eséka, la souvenir reste vivace
signals.summary: 🇨🇲 Au Cameroun, dix ans après le drame ferroviaire d’Eséka, qui a fait officiellement 79 morts le 21 octobre 2016, les familles des victimes attendent toujours de faire leur deuil, malgré la condamnation de Camrail à les indemniser.

signals.title: Dix ans après la catastrophe ferroviaire d'Eséka, le Cameroun toujours en deuil
signals.summary: Il y a tout juste 10 ans, un train de la société Camrail déraillait à Eséka, au Cameroun, tuant 79 personnes et en blessant au moins 552. Pour les victimes et leurs proches, les blessures sont encore béantes, certaines familles n’ayant pas encore pu faire leur deuil, faute de corps, et certains attendant toujours d’être indemnisés. Retour sur la plus grave catastrophe ferroviaire du pays avec un reportage de Marcel Amoko, Richard Tessoh et Giresse Nganaa.

signals.title: Déraillement d’un train à Eséka : 10 ans après la catastrophe, le Cameroun se souvient
signals.summary: Dix ans après l'accident ferroviaire le plus grave du Cameroun, les proches des victimes n'arrivent toujours pas à faire leur deuil. Le 21 octobre 2016, un train de la société Camrail déraillait à Eséka, à une centaine de kilomètres de Yaoundé, causant la mort de 79 personnes. Camrail, filiale du groupe Bolloré à l'époque, a été reconnue coupable d’homicide involontaire par la justice camerounaise et condamnée à indemniser les victimes.

signals.title: South Africa's Andrews died of tear in artery around heart - autopsy
signals.summary: Former Sale player Hyron Andrews - who was found dead at his new team's hotel base before a Champions Cup match - died of natural causes, an autopsy finds.

signals.title: Government Approves Regulations On Decentralized Governance
signals.summary: [AIM] Maputo -- The Mozambican government on Tuesday approved regulations defining the functioning of executive bodies responsible for decentralized governance.

signals.title: Another Leader of Mondlane's Party Killed
signals.summary: [Mozambique News Reports And Clippings] Araújo Tendence, a senior member of Anamola in Mopeia, Zambézia, was shot dead Friday (9 Oct) evening at his home. Anamola (National Alliance for a Free and Autonomous Mozambique) is the political party led by Mondlane, and founded in August 2025. Since then, Mondlane says that almost 60 members have been killed, with no investigations of the murders. Anamola has also reported that Cândido António, a party official in KaTembe…

signals.title: Malian Army and Rebels Committing Abuses Against Civilians, Rights Group Says
signals.summary: [RFI] The Malian army and its Russian paramilitary allies have killed civilians in violation of international law, Human Rights Watch (HRW) has said in a new report, which also confirms the al-Qaeda-linked jihadist group (JNIM) summarily executed Malian soldiers following an attack on a military convoy in July.

signals.title: Senegal - Faj Calls On the African Commission and African States to Protect Journalists, Investigate Attacks and End the Culture of Impunity
signals.summary: [IFJ] In presenting the statement, FAJ President Omar Faruk Osman, said that the African Charter has promised to protect the rights of journalists. However, 40 years after the coming into force of the Charter, African journalists are still being killed, abducted tortured and detained. "Newsrooms have been raided or shut down. Equipment has been seized. Reporters have faced censorship, surveillance, travel bans, online abuse and gender-based violence. Broad laws have been…

signals.title: Angola Claim Southern African Derby to Start TotalEnergies CAF Futsal Afcon With a Big Win Over Mozambique
signals.summary: [CAF] Angola started their group B campaign with a win at the 2026 TotalEnergies CAF Futsal Africa Cup of Nations after beating Southern African neighbours Mozambique 5-1 on Tuesday at the Complexe Sportif Prince Moulay Abdellah in Rabat.

signals.title: Nduhungirehe, Mali President Discuss Bilateral Relations
signals.summary: [New Times] The Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation, Olivier Nduhungirehe, on Tuesday, October 13, met with Mali's Transitional President Gen Assimi Goïta for a discussion on bilateral relations, regional security and African integration.

signals.title: Mourners killed by Kenya police at Odinga national farewell not part of violence, BBC finds
signals.summary: After analysing 1,500 videos and images of the Raila Odinga memorial, Africa Eye finds that those killed were far from the scuffles.

signals.title: Boad Funds 420 Social Housing Units in Ivory Coast
signals.summary: [Daba Finance] The Government of Côte d'Ivoire has officially launched construction work on 420 social and affordable housing units in Yamoussoukro. This project is part of a national emergency program to build 25,000 housing units. The West African Development Bank (BOAD) is providing financial support for this initiative.

signals.title: Ivory Coast Issues a 20-Year Bond, a First for the Region
signals.summary: [Daba Finance] Côte d'Ivoire issued a 20-year Obligation Assimilable du Trésor (OAT) on the West African Monetary Union (UMOA) government securities market. The issuance took place on Tuesday, October 6, 2026. This marks the first time an issuer from the Union has borrowed over such a long term on the regional financial market.

signals.title: Luanda-Lusaka Commercial Flights to Start This Year
signals.summary: [ANGOP] Luanda -- Direct commercial flights connecting Luanda and Lusaka are scheduled to launch later this year, Angolan Minister of Transport Ricardo Viegas D'Abreu announced Tuesday during a visit to the Zambian capital.

signals.title: Malian Army Retakes Strategic City of Kidal After Tuareg Separatists Withdraw
signals.summary: [RFI] The Malian army and its Russian allies entered the strategic northern city of Kidal on Tuesday without resistance after Tuareg separatists announced a tactical withdrawal, five months after government forces were driven out.

signals.title: Afcon 2027 Qualifiers - Coach Aliou Cissé Highlights Confidence Against Malawi
signals.summary: [ANGOP] Luanda -- National coach Aliou Cissé stated, on Monday (05) in Luanda, that the team is confident and will do everything possible to secure the three points, despite acknowledging the difficulties that Malawi may present in Tuesday's match.

signals.title: Afcon 2027 Qualifiers - Angola Tunes Up to Host Malawi
signals.summary: [ANGOP] Luanda -- The national football team trained on Sunday (04) at the 22 de Junho Stadium as part of preparations for Tuesday's match against Malawi, in the second matchday of Group B of the qualifiers for the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON).

signals.title: Lone Star's AFCON Road Gets Tougher After Mali Loss
signals.summary: [Liberian Observer] Liberia's long and agonizing wait for a return to the Africa Cup of Nations suffered another painful blow Tuesday night when a late Martial Tia strike condemned the Lone Star to a 1-0 defeat against Mali before a roaring crowd at the Samuel Kanyon Doe Sports Complex.

signals.title: Did Tommy Songo Sustain Injury Before Liberia's Defeat to Mali?
signals.summary: [Liberian Investigator] MONROVIA -- Questions have emerged over whether goalkeeper Tommy Songo sustained an injury after he withdrew from Liberia's starting lineup during the warm-up before Tuesday's 1-0 defeat to Mali in the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers.

signals.title: Egypt, Senegal and Ghana Face Pressure to Relaunch Drive for 2027 Afcon
signals.summary: [RFI] Continental powerhouses Egypt, Ghana and Senegal will attempt to get their 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifying campaigns back on track on Tuesday after opening round setbacks last week.

signals.title: Lone Star Seek to Bounce Back Against Mali in AFCON Qualifying Clash
signals.summary: [Liberian Investigator] Liberia returns home Tuesday to face Mali in a Group K match in the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers at the Samuel Kanyon Doe Sports Complex.

signals.title: L'Afrique face à une épidémie complexe d'Ebola après sa propagation au Nigeria
signals.summary: Le Kenya a signalé son deuxième décès dû à Ebola, a annoncé le ministère de la Santé vendredi soir, la victime étant le troisième cas confirmé dans ce pays d'Afrique de l'Est.

signals.title: RDC : à Beni, la lutte contre Ebola se heurte encore à la méfiance et aux croyances
signals.summary: Alors que l'épidémie d’Ebola fait rage dans l’est de la République démocratique du Congo, la désinformation est omniprésente et les communautés, longtemps négligées par le gouvernement central de Kinshasa, se méfient des autorités.

signals.title: We're Not Responsible for Hunger in Nigeria - PDP Fires Back At APC
signals.summary: [Vanguard] The Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) on Monday says it is not responsible for hunger in Nigeria, advising the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC) to stop the blame game.

signals.title: Fear and misinformation hamper Ebola response in DR Congo
signals.summary: In eastern Congo, fear and misinformation are complicating the Ebola outbreak. After losing her sister and father, 27-year-old Zawadi Kavira Musubao was told she had been poisoned. A pastor blamed evil spirits, while a traditional healer’s potion failed to help.

signals.title: Troops Kill Eight Suspected Terrorists, Rescue Three Abductees in Three States - Military
signals.summary: [Premium Times] The military said the operations in Katsina, Kaduna and Zamfara also led to the recovery of four firearms and three motorcycles.

signals.title: Nigeria May Be Ebola-Free Dec 7 - Govt
signals.summary: [Daily Trust] The Federal Government has said Nigeria could declare the Ebola outbreak over by December 7, 2026, if no further confirmed or probable cases are detected and the country meets the conditions stipulated by the World Health Organisation (WHO).

signals.title: Le Niger dénonce une attaque de drone du Tchad avec «l’appui de la France»
signals.summary: Le Niger convoque l’ambassadeur du Tchad à la suite d'une frappe de drone sur son territoire. Dans un communiqué lu à la télévision nationale ce lundi 26 octobre, le gouvernement nigérien dénonce « une frappe aérienne par drone menée depuis le territoire du Tchad » et à laquelle aurait, selon lui, participé la France. L’incident survient alors que les relations ne cessent de se dégrader entre Niamey et Ndjamena.

signals.title: Uganda, Kenya Sign Three Tourism, Trade Deals At Mombasa Summit
signals.summary: [Nile Post] Ugandan and Kenyan private-sector bodies have signed three agreements on tourism, trade and investment at a regional summit in Mombasa.

signals.title: 22 Rescued As Church Building Collapses in Entebbe
signals.summary: [Nile Post] Even the prophets did not see this one coming. And it was tragic by all means.

signals.title: Water Minister Denies Bronkhorstspruit Illnesses an 'Outbreak' - Despite 833 Reported Cases
signals.summary: [Daily Maverick] Minister Pemmy Majodina denies a water-related illness outbreak in Bronkhorstspruit, as officials point to infrastructure failures and residents' water use, while offering no firm timeline for restoring a safe piped water supply.

signals.title: JOJ Dakar 2026: les Makis Ladies de Madagascar à l’assaut de la compétition de rugby à 7 [2/5]
signals.summary: Elles vont représenter Madagascar lors de la compétition de rugby à 7 aux Jeux olympiques de la jeunesse de Dakar, les Makis Ladies achèvent cette semaine une préparation intense à Antananarivo, après avoir participé à un stage en Tunisie mi-octobre. Techniques de mêlée, de plaquage, stratégies d’attaque et de défense : si rien n’est laissé au hasard, c’est avant tout grâce à leur mental que ces jeunes sportives et leur coach disent vouloir faire la différence.

signals.title: Le Premier ministre du Sénégal "convaincu" qu’une entente est possible avec le Pastef
signals.summary: Dans un entretien accordé à France 24, le Premier ministre du Sénégal assure que le gouvernement peut apporter “des réponses”, alors que le pays risque un nouveau blocage autour du texte de loi de finances rectificative, rejeté par les députés Pastef le 23 octobre dernier. "Je reste convaincu que nous pouvons nous entendre", affirme-t-il, à quelques jours du coup d’envoi, à Dakar, des Jeux olympiques de la jeunesse.

signals.title: City Hall Never Submitted an Inquiry File On Eastleigh Building Collapse, DPP Says
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- The Director of Public Prosecutions (DPP) has denied receiving an inquiry file from Nairobi City County over alleged wrongdoing in the construction of the Eastleigh building that collapsed, directing the Directorate of Criminal Investigations (DCI) to investigate the tragedy.

signals.title: Congo-Brazza : des jeunes manifestent contre les coupures d'électricité
signals.summary: 🇨🇬 À Brazzaville, des jeunes ont manifesté samedi contre les coupures d’électricité. Une mobilisation inédite dans la capitale congolaise. Dans certains quartiers, les habitants restent des semaines sans courant.

signals.title: Kenya : la Croix-Rouge forme ses équipes à la prise en charge des cas d’Ebola
signals.summary: Alors que le Kenya a recensé neuf cas d’Ebola, dont deux décès, la Croix-Rouge kényane intensifie ses exercices de préparation. L’OMS alerte sur la complexification de l’épidémie, après la détection d’un cas importé au Nigeria, premier pays d’Afrique de l’Ouest touché par l'épidémie.

signals.title: Social Grant Officials Fired As Death Threats Rock Fraud Investigations
signals.summary: [Scrolla] The South African Social Security Agency has dismissed 65 workers for misconduct since April 2025, with the Eastern Cape recording 19 dismissals. Chief executive Themba Matlou has condemned death threats against officials investigating wrongdoing and warned that staff who abuse their positions will face consequences.

signals.title: Ebola - Uganda Restricts Transit for Travellers From DR Congo
signals.summary: [Premium Times] Uganda had earlier battled an outbreak of Ebola disease caused by the Bundibugyo virus, which was declared on 15 May 2026 after cases were imported from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC).

signals.title: Une semaine avant le coup d'envoi des Jeux olympiques de la jeunesse
signals.summary: Une semaine avant l'ouverture des Jeux olympiques de la jeunesse de Dakar, un évènement historique pour le continent africain, nous entendrons le président du comité d'organisation des JOJ sur les enjeux de cette 4ème édition et comment malgré la situation économique difficile, le Sénégal se prépare à accueillir 2 700 jeunes athlètes venus des quatre coins du monde.

signals.title: Au Sénégal, Pastef rejette le budget rectificatif
signals.summary: Alors que le pays fait face à une dette équivalente à 132 % du PIB, le parti d’Ousmane Sonko a rejeté le budget rectificatif en commission. Il dénonce notamment les coupes dans les dépenses sociales et appelle à la protection du pouvoir d’achat des Sénégalais.

signals.title: Tchad : quatre suspects arrêtés à Miski, après les tensions dans le Tibesti
signals.summary: 🇹🇩 Au Tchad, malgré les accords de paix signés en 2025, les tensions persistent dans le Tibesti. Après des affrontements entre l’armée et des comités d’autodéfense, quatre suspects ont été arrêtés à la suite de l’attaque de Miski.

signals.title: Ébola gagne du terrain : au Nigeria, le "choc" après l'annonce d'un premier cas de souche Bundibugyo
signals.summary: Le Nigeria confirme un premier cas d'Ebola. La patiente, une femme arrivée dans le pays à bord d’un vol international en provenance d’Ouganda, a été admise dans un hôpital privé à Abuja. Où en est l’épidémie aujourd’hui, alors que le Kenya est également touché, avec 9 cas ?

signals.title: Un premier cas de virus Ebola enregistré au Nigeria, dans la capitale Abuja
signals.summary: Une femme arrivée au Nigeria par avion en provenance de l'Ouganda est porteuse du virus Ebola, a annoncé mardi le gouvernement nigérian, qui recense par ailleurs 44 cas contacts étroits. L’épidémie, déclarée en mai en République démocratique du Congo où elle a dépassé les 9 000 cas pour 4 381 décès, s’étend à plusieurs pays africains.

signals.title: Chapo Calls for Answers Regarding Crash of Machel's Aircraft
signals.summary: [AIM] Maputo -- Mozambican President Daniel Chapo has called for continued efforts to establish the circumstances surrounding the death of the country's first president, Samora Moisés Machel, who died in a plane crash in Mbuzini, South Africa, 40 years ago.

signals.title: A New Study Suggests HIV Prevention Has Stalled. but There May Be a Silver Lining
signals.summary: [spotlight] The two key goals in managing the HIV epidemic are getting as many people with the virus as possible onto ARV treatment and reducing the number of new infections. The results of a study from KZN, published in The Lancet HIV, suggest we're stalling on the prevention front. The study is well done and important, but the situation may not be as bleak as the authors suggest.

signals.summary: [Premium Times] The Ministry of Health said returning Ugandans with a history of travel to the DRC would bear the cost of their quarantine.

signals.summary: Lancée par les régimes militaires du Mali, du Burkina Faso et du Niger, Tafouk TV vise à imposer le narratif souverainiste de l’Alliance des États du Sahel. Encouragé par la Russie, ce média émerge alors que la répression contre les journalistes locaux s’intensifie.

signals.summary: [Vanguard] The Federal Government has launched new trade intelligence tools to help Nigerian businesses access international markets, attract productive investments and strengthen local industries' competitiveness as part of efforts to build a $1 trillion economy by 2030.
